note: Questions that must be answered before a decision can reasonably be made. 'Known' lists only what is verified in the repo's sources (S-ids). 'Missing' lists what is not verified. 'How to discover' lists the suggested route (see Suggestions page).

rows.question: Where can we get historical point spreads, totals and moneylines (opening and closing) for NFL games, with a licence that allows analysis?
rows.known: No odds data has been fetched. NFL.com (S02) publishes schedules and final scores but not betting lines.
rows.missing: Source, licence terms, seasons covered, and whether closing lines exist.
rows.how_to_discover: SG-03 (licensed odds vendor evaluation) or SG-04 (public-data check). Requires your choice.

rows.question: Which player-prop markets can we legally record and use, and what historical prop lines exist?
rows.known: NFL memo (reported by ESPN, S08) says the league has limited or prohibited prop categories: inherently objectionable (e.g. injuries), officiating-related, determinable by one person in one play, and pre-determined. NFL personnel are barred from prediction-market football propositions (S09).
rows.missing: The memo text itself, the current list of prohibited markets, and any historical prop-line data.
rows.how_to_discover: Retrieve the NFL memo primary text (F-11) and check each prop type against it.

rows.question: Is it legal for you (a resident of Mexico City, MX) to place bets on NFL games, in person or online, and does the bookmaker need a specific online authorisation?
rows.known: Ley Federal de Juegos y Sorteos (S05): Art. 1 prohibits gambling and betting games nationwide unless the law permits them; Art. 3-4: SEGOB regulates bets and a SEGOB permit is required for any place where betting games run; Art. 12 sets penalties for unpermitted operators. The Cámara ficha (S06) lists no amending decrees.
rows.missing: Official SEGOB/DGJS statement on online sports betting; whether the 2023 regulation cited by secondary sources exists and what it says (F-09); whether player-side use is penalised (not stated in reviewed articles).
rows.how_to_discover: Ask the DGJS (official channel) or obtain a Mexican legal opinion. Not resolvable from sources reviewed.
rows.status: Open - legal risk, decision needed before any real-money use

rows.question: Can we build a multi-season injury history from the official NFL weekly reports?
rows.known: The NFL.com injury page has a season selector (2026 back to 1965) and a week selector (Weeks 1-10 shown for 2026) (S01).
rows.missing: Whether every season/week is available in the same format; rate of access; whether the page can be scraped under nfl.com terms.
rows.how_to_discover: Sample 2 earlier weeks by hand through the fetch tool; check nfl.com terms (see Q-12).

rows.question: What are the exact official NFL injury-report rules (filing days, deadline, definitions of Out / Doubtful / Questionable)?
rows.known: Secondary sources (S12) describe Wed/Thu/Fri practice reports and Friday game status, and 'Out / Doubtful / Questionable'. Official 2017 Personnel (Injury) Report Policy cited by S12 was not retrieved.
rows.how_to_discover: Locate the policy PDF on operations.nfl.com (F-12).
